title: Confession and Alibi
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Amberdale, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
